_comment: Implementation-stage classification declarations for the milestone-8 legacy import (D-Legacy phase 1, WF-M8a), consumed by scripts/workflow_fingerprint.py's load_implementation_stage_classification(). Originally scoped to what actually changed between milestone-8's own base commit (2d09ec02252848124d0e1accfbefb57dc8561872, the commit before its plan doc was committed) and its reviewed head (dc4381a348c114ec4967174c4e6a76ac00b1a537, the round-4-approved commit docs/ACTIVE_MILESTONE.md records as integrated). 'protected' means the content technical_approval binds to (source, test, build, migration files); 'excluded' means design/tracking documentation that is not itself an implementation deliverable, mirroring workflow-v2-1-core-artifacts.json's own category discipline. Any path named in neither set fails closed (UnclassifiedPathError). Widened at D-Legacy phase 2 (WF-M8b): the repository is multi-work-item, and workflow-v2-1-core's own concurrent process-tooling commits (its commands, scripts, and docs/ai-workflow/ content) land in this same base_commit..HEAD range without ever being milestone-8's own implementation deliverable -- excluded here by prefix, symmetric with workflow-v2-1-core-artifacts.json's own docs/milestones/ exclusion for the reverse direction. IMPORTANT: this widening deliberately changes what any_commit_scoped hash recomputation over the *original* base_commit..reviewed_content_commit window produces (the full classification config is embedded in that hash's own projection, so any edit here -- even excluded-only -- changes it), which is exactly why WF-M8b's own promotion-time freshness check (promote_legacy_work_item, any_protected_path_changed_since) is a direct protected/excluded-path existence check over reviewed_content_commit..HEAD, never a hash-reproduction comparison against the already-fixed, never-recomputed approved_review_content_id stored in WORKFLOW_STATE.json. workflow_state_demo_test.py's TestLegacyImportAgainstRealMilestone8 proves the stored ID still reproduces from the declarations *as WF-M8a originally authored them* (commit 2baf7bcfdd12006335e65f7fbae41e5d1fa4a8e3), not from this file's current, later-widened content.

protected_prefixes.app/: product source, test, and Room schema/migration content Milestone 8 changed (CP0-CP16, P0)

excluded_prefixes..claude/commands/: workflow-v2-1-core's own workflow-command files -- a concurrent process work item's tooling, out of scope for milestone-8's product implementation (WF-M8b)
excluded_prefixes.scripts/: workflow-v2-1-core's own tooling scripts (fingerprint/state modules and tests), same reasoning as .claude/commands/ above
excluded_prefixes.docs/ai-workflow/: workflow-v2-1-core's own plan/state/registry/requirements/workflow-doc content, including this declarations file itself -- out of scope for milestone-8's product implementation
excluded_prefixes.docs/milestones/: product milestone plan/execution artifacts, including this milestone's own doc (wherever archived) and any other product milestone's docs -- not an implementation deliverable, replaces the narrower now-stale docs/milestones/active/ exact paths this file listed at import time
excluded_prefixes..github/: operational GitHub/CI configuration -- milestone-8 never protected any CI file as part of its own reviewed scope; later CI wiring is a concurrent work item's own change

excluded_paths..gitignore: repository housekeeping, not an implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.CLAUDE.md: process-command depointer edits implement a concurrent work item's design, not milestone-8's own implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.docs/ACTIVE_MILESTONE.md: product-milestone narrative, not an implementation deliverable -- its final accepted/waived-review wording legitimately lands in a commit after the reviewed head
excluded_paths.docs/ROADMAP.md: product milestone ordering, not an implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.docs/TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md: design-decision record, not an implementation deliverable
excluded_paths.docs/improvements/FUNCTIONAL_FEATURE_AUD: product feature-tracking document, not source/test/build content
